extraction: VizieR asu-tsv; Richard et al. 2014 MNRAS 444,268 tables 1-6, one per HFF cluster. Cluster/table mapping taken from the catalogue's own 'clusters' table (FileName column): table1=Abell 2744, table2=MACS J0416, table3=MACS J0717, table4=MACS J1149, table5=AbellS 1063, table6=Abell 370. Concatenated with a leading cluster column. RA/Dec in this catalogue are SEXAGESIMAL strings (VizieR types A11/A12), not decimal degrees; they were converted to decimal degrees for the ra_deg/dec_deg columns and the original sexagesimal string is preserved in the notes column.
note: Uniform cross-cluster baseline covering all six Hubble Frontier Fields clusters in one schema. Per cluster (images / systems / spectroscopic): Abell 2744 52/17/8; MACS J0416.1-2403 47/17/24; MACS J0717.5+3745 47/16/29; MACS J1149.5+2223 35/12/9; Abell S1063 / RXC J2248.7-4431 41/14/16; Abell 370 34/12/11. zprior = SPECTROSCOPIC, zmodel = LENS-MODEL-OPTIMISED (flagged 'model'); '_sys' suffix means the value was measured/derived for the system and propagated to this image. NO arc position angles. NO time delays.
